checkpoint.description: Post-Charity Event career checkpoint; first observed Amateur Package unlock in Fight Store.

private_artifact.policy: Hashes only. Savestate and extracted RAM remain outside Git.

charity_event_result.observed_runtime_rule: A knockdown ends the current round; if the downed boxer rises the next round begins; the bout continues until a boxer fails to rise.

fight_store_unlock.name: AMATEUR PACKAGE
fight_store_unlock.runtime_popup_summary: Congratulations popup reports that the Amateur Package has been unlocked in the Fight Store.
fight_store_unlock.significance: First observed store/progression unlock in the controlled career; potentially useful for identifying career milestone gates and existing unlock infrastructure for Amateur Career 2.0.

confirmed_field_deltas_checkpoint_11_to_.name: career_bank
confirmed_field_deltas_checkpoint_11_to_.evidence: Matches the visible Charity Event net pay exactly.

unlock_or_progression_candidates.evidence: Stayed 0 through controlled checkpoints 1-11, changed to 1 at the same checkpoint as the first observed Amateur Package unlock, and is also 1 in the preserved 20-0 late-career baseline. Could be the package unlock or a coincident milestone/progression flag; not yet named as confirmed.
First observed non-zero transition at checkpoint 12; may be an unlock/event bitmask or unrelated post-event state. Requires another store/progression transition or static writer trace.
Changed materially across the Charity Event checkpoint and may be a progression/event counter; semantics not assigned.

overhaul_implications: Retail career already exposes a gated Fight Store unlock path tied to career progression, giving the overhaul an existing milestone/unlock mechanism to investigate rather than inventing one blindly.
The Charity Event proves that special event archetypes can alter not only presentation and purse but also round-ending and fight-ending rules.

Because the Amateur Package unlock coincides with several persistent field changes, the next static RE target should be the code path that formats/triggers the Amateur Package popup and writes the candidate progression fields.
next_capture: Open the Fight Store and capture the Amateur Package details (price, description, requirements/effects) with screenshots; no additional savestate is necessary unless purchasing it changes persistent state.
If the package is purchased, take one pre-purchase and one post-purchase savestate to distinguish unlock-availability state from ownership/activation state.
Continue prioritizing the first UNRANKED-to-numeric-rank and Amateur-to-Pro transitions.
